global: This is a bowl of rich, reddish-brown ramen broth, topped with a large nori sheet, tender chashu pork, and menma bamboo shoots. It sits in a white bowl with blue floral patterns, on a dark tray under warm, ambient lighting.

regions.background: Black tray with textured surface, rectangular shape, ridged pattern, sits on wooden table.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue floral pattern and thin blue rim, smooth glossy surface.
regions.soup: The broth with noodles shows rich, reddish-brown liquid swirling around thin, pale yellow noodles and tender meat pieces.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green-black, textured, rectangular, with visible surface wrinkles and slight curling edges.
regions.meat: Chashu pork appears as tender, browned slices with visible marbling and slightly glistening surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale, translucent, slightly curved pieces with visible fibrous texture and subtle brownish streaks.
